explanation: The worked solution confirms fundamental solutions e^x and e^{-x}, giving A=[[1,-1],[e,-e^{-1}]]. Therefore |det(A)|=e-1/e>0, so the homogeneous BVP has only y≡0. The difference of any two inhomogeneous solutions would solve that homogeneous BVP, proving there is at most one solution.
